koreanify.config.option.command_search_k: When enabled, Korean/Jamo matching in tab-completion only applies if the input contains Korean characters. When disabled, substring matching is applied to all input (e.g. /mode → /gamemode).
koreanify.config.option.latin_as_hangul_: When enabled, a query typed with the IME left off is also read as the Hangul those keys would have produced (e.g. ekdl → 다이아).
koreanify.config.option.prevent_windows_: When enabled, Windows IME full-width mode is immediately reverted to half-width mode.
